Going down-left would leave number 2 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes up-left.
Number 2 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going to number 3 leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes up-left.
Number 3 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going left would force the line onto number 17 before its turn; going down-left leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes down-right.
The line must go left: down-left is number 7, which comes later; down-right is number 8, which comes later.
I can't rule out down-left or left yet, so I'll make an educated guess: down-left.
Going up-left would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going down-right, the next 2 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (-2,2). So the line goes down-left.
Going right leaves no safe move afterwards; going down-left, the next 11 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (-2,3). So the line goes down-right.
Going left would leave number 6 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going down-left would cut off the bottom edge (9 cells) (and 1 more option fails too). So the line goes up-right.
Number 6 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going right would force the line onto number 8 before its turn; going down-right would strand number 7: it would be left with only one free neighbour. So the line goes up-left.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes right.

Going up-left leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes left.
The line must go up-right: up-left is number 13, which comes later.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes up-left.
Going up-left would turn number 15 into a dead-end pocket with no way out; going up-right would force the line onto number 18 before its turn. So the line goes left.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes up-right.
Going right would force the line onto number 18 before its turn. So the line goes up-right.
Going down-right would force the line onto number 18 before its turn. So the line goes up-right.
Number 16 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going down-right would turn number 17 into a dead-end pocket with no way out. So the line goes right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down-left.
Going left would wall in number 19, the last number. So the line goes down-left.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes up-left.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
